def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find objects by color
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: cells[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    r=c=0
    for col in sorted(cells):
        pts=cells[col]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        for dr in range(h):
            for dc in range(w):
                if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc]=col
        r+=h-1; c+=w-1
    return out

def transform(g):
    from collections import defaultdict
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: cells[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    order=sorted(cells,key=lambda col:min(p[1] for p in cells[col]))
    r=c=0
    for col in order:
        pts=cells[col]
        h=max(p[0] for p in pts)-min(p[0] for p in pts)+1
        w=max(p[1] for p in pts)-min(p[1] for p in pts)+1
        for dr in range(h):
            for dc in range(w):
                if 0<=r+dr<H and 0<=c+dc<W: out[r+dr][c+dc]=col
        r+=h-1; c+=w-1
    return out
